messages.staleMessage: The draft has changed. Run the check again to see its current results.
messages.manualHint: Clipboard access was unavailable. The task is selected for manual copying.
messages.taskIntro: Use $tangyixiao-workflow to revise these release notes for maintainers. Read this repository’s contribution guidance, release conventions and actual changes. Preserve verified facts, verify the findings, and return a revised draft with any missing evidence called out.

notes-no-duplicate-title: The opening heading repeats the release title. Remove it and start with a useful change.
The opening heading does not repeat the release title.
notes-no-private-instructions: The draft mentions a private instruction or approval. Describe the product change directly.
No private instruction or approval wording matched the rule.
notes-no-private-machine-state: The draft mentions private preview state. Move that detail into the task record.
No private machine-state wording matched the rule.

advisories.local-debug-history: Move local debugging history into a development record unless it explains a user-facing issue.
advisories.validation-in-main-copy: Keep test evidence concise and linked or folded. Lead with changes and installation impact.
advisories.delivery-report-in-main-copy: Move evidence boundaries into verification records and keep concrete user-facing limitations in the notes.

messages.storageUnavailable: The other language opens in a new tab. Your edited draft stays here for copying.
